newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed in listless trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed on listless trading due to continued absence of participation from consumers, dealers said.
"There is hardly any interest in the market. Most people are away for the year-end holidays," a dealer said, adding that trading for next week looked set to stay inactive.
Traders said they were only expecting fresh demand in the new year.
They added that supply of raw materials was still short, owing to seasonal rains which have reduced tapping at rubber plantations.
At the close, January RSS1 buyer eased a cent to 315.00 cents ($1.25) a kg, while January SMR 20 buyer was up half a cent at 309.50 cents.
The INRO five-day average was 241.86 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Dec 26 from 242.21 on Dec 24. The daily indicator was 241.57 against 241.69.
